= verbatim-styles(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Substitution tests
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-01
:blank:
:source-highlighter: syntect
:word: expanded

== Name
verbatim-styles - formatting in verbatim blocks

== Description

[source,rust,subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
----
B01 *Bold* _Italic_ `Mono` #Mark# ^Super^ ~Sub~
B02 *_Nested_* [.underline]#Under# [.line-through]#Strike#
B03 *two  spaces* and *first
  second* after.
B04 *{word}* *{blank}* link:https://example.org[Literal]
----

[source,rust,subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes,macros"]
----
B05 *Bold* _Italic_ *{word}* *{blank}* link:https://example.org[Live]
----

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
....
B06 *Bold* _Italic_ "`Curved`" '`Single`'
B07 \*literal* **double** __double__ é*literal*é
....

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes,callouts"]
----
B08 *Bold* {word} <1>
----

<1> Callout stays attached.
